title: Focal-SAM: Focal Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Long-Tailed Classification
mechanism: Class-wise sharpness penalties, heavier on tail classes, without extra backpropagations.
adaptation: Per-class pixel losses over the 24 classes, focal weight on sharpness for inactive, crack, splice, gridline, edge_dark; run only if plain SAM helps.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + Focal-SAM, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF + SAM. Metric: inactive IoU, gridline/splice/edge_dark IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill: no tail-class IoU gain >= 0.02 over PF + SAM.
evidence: R (abstract): better than ImbSAM and CC-SAM on long-tailed classification with traditional and foundation models.
